common_rules.unit: flat 1u per first-sight candidate, settled WIN/LOSS only
common_rules.statistic: ROI with 90% matchday block-bootstrap CI; CLV vs last committed pre-kickoff snapshot price
common_rules.multiple_comparison_family: all 7 hypotheses below, Benjamini-Hochberg at q=0.10 on one-sided p(ROI>0)
common_rules.pass: N >= min_n AND matchdays >= 8 AND ROI 90% CI lower bound > 0 AND mean CLV >= 0 (where FAIR/CLV available) AND BH q <= 0.10 -> FORWARD_SUPPORTED (CONFIRMED only by a separate preregistered evaluator, never by this study)
common_rules.fail: N >= min_n AND ROI 90% CI upper bound < 0 -> REJECTED; or N >= 2*min_n with ROI <= 0 -> REJECTED
common_rules.otherwise: ACCRUING (INSUFFICIENT if the market stops producing candidates)
common_rules.frozen: no band, league list, side, odds range or criterion changes after registration
